kind: Native MatchControllerV2 active-side leaf, candidate writers and conditional offline evidence; no kernel repair

getter.behavior: Read controller byte and overwrite the output byte; no side-string parsing in this getter.
getter.boundary: Leaf ends ret, independently decoded; exploratory128-byte probes are not counted as complete functions.

live_layout.scope: Current runtime FField/UScriptStruct headers, offsets and widths cross-checked with stable rereads.

candidate_scan.search: Literal disp32 cf9 in executable .text, then decode containing pdata ranges; no claim of alias/bulk coverage
candidate_scan.limits: Some pdata entries are chained code fragments rather than independent complete functions. Wider overlapping stores, memset/bulk initialization, aliases and computed addresses remain outside this scan.

writer_observations.input: Upstream stack-string producer unresolved; chained parent root0x4ad7350.

writer_observations.behavior: Old byte1 ->2; all other byte values ->1. No assertion every byte is reachable in actual match.
Native thunk tail-jumps0x4b08780; chained range root matches, prefix binds rdi=rcx and zeros ebp, selected store writes bpl to cf9. Full helper and call lifecycle not certified.

comparison.literal_encoding: ASCII left, compared with UTF-16 input; literal also adjacent ASCII right
comparison.behavior: ASCII comparisons fold A..Z to a..z. Selected write fragment returns1 when compared input matches left,2 otherwise. Zero Num uses controlled empty fallback and returns2.
comparison.limits: Selected FString view/window only, not JSON decoding, all Unicode handling, input validation or full callback execution.

offline.engine: Unicorn, copied code with synthetic object/closure/FString/stack; no game function invocation
offline.memory_checks: Getter leaves object bytes unchanged; selected parse/switch windows change only cf9 in the synthetic object.
offline.runtime_data: Switch SSE multiplier is stable-read mutable runtime data; not falsely asserted byte-identical to disk. It does not determine the side predicate.

deepseek.scope: Six byte-write matches plus up to15 preceding/following instructions; no semantics/repository edits/publishing
deepseek.narrative_correction: Worker described rejected matches as four reads plus one RIP and one size8. Independent decoding shows five byte reads and one RIP-relative size8 LEA; RIP/size8 are the same instruction. Artifact six writes and contexts match exactly.

tests.new_tests: 2152 offline native leaf/window vectors; independent Capstone inventory, unwind chain and live layout checks.

limitations: Six direct byte stores are candidates, not all class-bound writers. Some closure owner types and callback routes are unresolved; an equal displacement alone does not prove receiver identity.
Wider stores overlapping cf9, bulk zeroing/constructors, computed-address writes, aliases and native caller scheduling still require inspection.
ResetVariablesForResync scalar-clear identity is verified, but its complete container/helper semantics and all actual invokers/order are not.
Full reset/resync machine-code functions, allocator/session/actor callback effects and actual post-reset object state are not certified by selected windows.
MatchController active byte is distinct from GameMode active byte and GameState playingSide; do not dynamically substitute one for the saved StartingSide field.

No starting-side transport/import/default change. The controller byte might reflect initial source or progressed/recovered state at different phases; loader identity and action-recovery order must be established.
No historical replay authority, client writes, injection, code execution in the client or UI/campaign implementation.
next_audit: Broaden overlap/bulk-writer coverage and map the three match.start_side callback routes and reconstruction order, then integrate explicit starting-side metadata only with a verified phase contract.
